chunk_policy.single_page_over_target_policy: Preserve the page without image degradation; flag an exception. A chunk at or above 100,000,000 bytes fails the build.

processing: Original PDF page appearance retained without image downsampling. MS-4 source parts are referenced directly without duplicate PDF copies; their accompanying text comes from the upstream OCR pipeline. Other texts use pdftotext. Internal/non-URI annotations are omitted from split chunks; full MS-4 image-only source parts have no such links.
